entries.186962082cf2dc8c: It sells scientific computing computers that achieve ultra-high-speed, large-scale and high-precision calculations by building and tuning computing programs to suit uses such as scientific computing, simulation, computational chemistry and deep learning. It is also working on services that provide HPC computing capacity via the cloud.

entries.826bebc7a4dfcf63: This business provides solutions for scientific computing computers. In addition to selling high-performance computers with system integration tailored to customers' intended uses, it provides software program development and sales, contract computing and R&D support, and post-installation support on a one-stop basis. It has strengths in computational chemistry, and its focus areas are life science and materials science. A consolidated subsidiary in Vietnam also handles system sales and other operations. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥5,000 million.

entries.a85d0c99bab7c4b3: In addition to developing, selling and supporting original software programs for scientific computing, it also undertakes contract scientific computing and technical support, provides program acceleration services, and holds seminars on computational science.
entries.b04f482830903710: The business develops, manufactures and sells industrial computers built to customers' specified orders. As embedded computers, they are installed in manufacturing equipment, machine tools, measuring and inspection equipment, monitoring and control of infrastructure systems, medical devices, digital signage and other products. The company has an integrated structure covering everything from specification design and prototyping to mass production and post-shipment support, and supports long-term stable supply of products with the same specifications. Manufacturing is carried out at the company's domestic plant in Sosa, Chiba Prefecture. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥2,905 million.
